## Highlights

- Create safe draft tasks and understand when each task is runnable.
- Start tasks through local trigger keys, bulk Trigger Sets, or reliable filesystem events.
- Diagnose failed runs and keep adjustable Schedule and Activity layouts across sessions.
- Install the corrected release only after CI succeeds for its exact source commit.

Read the [full changelog](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/blob/v1.1.1/CHANGELOG.md#111---2026-09-05) for every change.
